subjectLabel: 爱尔奎特与远野志贵 encounter context

signals.summary: Original Arcueid source says she appears and is seventeen-sectioned by Tohno Shiki's demon-hunting impulse and Direct Death Mystic Eyes, then appears again the next day.
Original Arcueid source says that after being unexpectedly killed, she can revive but lacks enough power to deal with the enemy and pulls Shiki into cooperation to compensate for combat strength.
Remake Arcueid source says she is initially dismembered into seventeen pieces by Tohno Shiki and appears again the next day.
Remake Arcueid source says she pulls Shiki to her hotel room to hide from Nero Chaos's pursuit; this source line supports aftermath context but not the detailed activation scene.
